relationships.evidence_quote: Our results indicated that TTX perfusion significantly blocked the total macroscopic current, and then the addition of each of the cannabinoids further significantly inhibited Nav1.8, suggesting that all three compounds inhibit this channel (Fig. 2A).

relationships.evidence_quote: CBG inhibits both channels to a similar degree.

key_findings: CBD, CBG and CBN inhibit Nav1.8 in a state-dependent manner (IC50 ~2, 5, 16 uM), hyperpolarizing steady-state inactivation and slowing recovery from inactivation.
CBG was the most effective and inhibited firing of native DRG neurons; none of the compounds altered Nav1.8 expression.
